messages:
alice_pm: quick sync — we need a concrete plan for the console "inspect" toggle. product wants fast rollout for support teams but legal/infra are worried about PII and quota blowouts :grimacing:
ben_infra: +1. core concerns: (1) sampling by route+customer, (2) default redaction, (3) a breakglass path with stricter audit.
cara_privacy: strongly prefer redact-by-default. any inspect session that captures user prompt/response should mask emails, credit-cards, SSNs. we can add an allowlist for customer opt-in but must be explicit.
dave_sre: also: when inspect is on we spike egress and storage. need per-customer inspect quotas and a hard cap to avoid OOMs.
erin_console: UX question — support wants single-click enable for a session. can we make that scoped (15min, route-scoped) instead of org-wide? and show estimated quota cost before enabling?
ben_infra: technical sketch: expose 3 knobs: sample_rate (per-route), redact_mode (none/partial/full), session_ttl. default config: sample_rate=0.01, redact_mode=partial, session_ttl=900s. breakglass requires 2FA + audit log entry.
ben_infra: example config we could wire into console rollout:
```yaml
inspect:
  enabled: false
  sample_rate: 0.01
  redact_mode: partial
  session_ttl_seconds: 900
  breakglass: required
```
alice_pm: looks sensible. product asks for an obvious CTA: "Enable Inspect (cost: ~X tokens, retention: 7d)" before enabling. show small modal w/ checklist.
cara_privacy: redact_mode=partial should at minimum hash emails and mask long digit sequences. we have deid heuristics in repo but need to sync on false positives/negatives.
dave_sre: operationally we need an emergency cutoff: global inspect_kill_switch. also telemetry to track how many inspect sessions triggered and by whom.
erin_console: for the rollout UX: suggest canary to internal support first, then org admins, then all. Add an audit column in the console activity feed.
ben_infra: routing concern: if a customer is on dedicated infra, inspect should never send logs to hosted S3. default to customer-managed storage for Private/Dedicated. hosted tenants can use Redwood-managed storage with encryption at rest.
cara_privacy: add retention policy: 7 days default, 90 days max with special approval. store redaction version metadata per session so we can trace what heuristics applied.
alice_pm: action items: ben — implement sample_rate & breakglass, erin — modal + cost estimate mock, cara — finalize redaction rules and tests, dave — quota kill switch + telemetry events. planning to gate on internal canary (support) for 2 weeks.
ben_infra: noted. I'll drop a short RFC this afternoon and a CLI preview.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy of feature/inspect-modal to staging succeeded — 3 instances, green checks. :rocket:
alice_pm: thanks, team. we'll reconvene EOD Friday to decide canary go/no-go. any objections?
cara_privacy: none from me, assuming redaction tests land first.
dave_sre: fine, pending kill-switch in place.
erin_console: will post mockups in #design and tag you all.
alice_pm: closing thread — will post follow-up with timelines. :white_check_mark:
